forwardedMessage.content:
For those of you using `tn` or PR#1046, be aware if you enable the **Allow Dynamic Model Outputs** toggle you're changing the lat behavior of all models in addition to the long behavior. Only the Simple Plan model is designed to use this. Older models might have interesting or unexpected effects because it was not designed for this. One tester found lat would no longer lane center after enabling this toggle.

In other words I recommend not using it if you intend to see how a model is supposed to perform as designed.
